summary: R07 (v4): control-card {label, token} evidence reconciliation. Telegram maps the frozen contract to callback_data under a 64-byte UTF-8 cap (already present), and a button with an empty label/token now fails closed with ENCODE_ERROR instead of being silently skipped, so no control action can vanish and no value/id bypass remains. New protocol cases in test/protocol/telegram.test.mjs. Also removed a real flake: the login tests used a fixed now() of 150 with expiresAt 200 (a 50 ms window) so a loaded fsync could win the race and mark the session expired; the wait is now counter-based and the window generous (4 consecutive full unit runs green). Verification: npm run check passes (75 source files); npm test 410 pass / 0 fail.
